description: This Java source file defines the 'FindPhoneActivity' class, which manages the creation and updating of a wearable device notification that controls the phone's alarm status. It sets up notification actions linked to a service ('FindPhoneService') to toggle or cancel the alarm, and includes methods to update notification content dynamically.

classes.name: FindPhoneActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that creates and manages a notification for wearable devices to find the paired phone and control an alarm feature.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates a notification with actions to toggle and cancel the alarm, and displays it on the notification manager.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: A static method that updates the notification's content text and recounts it via the notification manager, reflecting current alarm state.
